result: The nested96-to768 contact energy/virtual-work and signed-mass checks passed all9 declared clocks. Only1clock has nonzero contact; this supports finite operator consistency but does not establish whole-impact correctness or spatial convergence.
priority: Finish/reap/compare the current three smooth-trajectory GPU jobs first. Keep q and v time checks separate; the long supported geometry/smooth forcing does not qualify the original free drop.

next_steps.action: If needed, extend read-only operator coverage to five predeclared original96 accepted states at first cumulative upward contact-impulse crossings of1%,10%,50%,90%,99% of its final contact impulse. Freeze selection/source/hash/caps before calls; retain every selected state/status. No new trajectory.
next_steps.purpose: Current nine output clocks include only one contact state; this covers loading/topology changes before attributing the remaining failure to waves.
next_steps.resources: CPU2, noGPU; prospective cap180s/RSS2GiB after geometry-only capacity estimate, not yet approved.

next_steps.action: Prepare a reviewed free-body force-only adapter around existing streamed bulk evaluation and exact full consistent-mass action. Preserve the original root128 contact gradient/energy and DOP853 law initially. Use a sparse/iterative SPD mass solve with original full-M residual; no mass lumping.
next_steps.purpose: Avoid dense mass scaling and separate spatial resolution from changing the time integrator. Existing TwoLevelP2/StreamingTwoLevelP2 constructors enforce a left clamp, and supported/long-domain variants encode other clamps; they cannot simply be reused with mask edits for a free drop.
next_steps.controls: Source/manufactured controls first, then original96/768 CPU/dense-versus-sparse full-M acceleration/force/energy parity and one bounded fixed-state capacity benchmark. Geometric coarse correction must match old.24m geometry and free-body scope. No new large solver or contact trajectory now.

next_steps.action: Only after source/parity/capacity review, propose a fresh original-physics finer spatial development pilot (for example12x6x6cells=2592tets) and later its own q/v time pair and another spatial level if justified. Freeze physical inputs and wall/memory/storage caps prospectively; retain all failures.
next_steps.purpose: Test whether local elastic phase/wave errors contract with resolution. The original768 velocity time failure remains separate, and one finer trajectory cannot establish dataset admission.
next_steps.resources: No honest runtime promise before the sparse-mass/streamed-force benchmark. Existing dense768 run had~100kRHS/~357s integration; finer wave/time counts and mass-solve iterations can multiply cost. Budget planning should allow tens of minutes to hours, not assume static/smooth timing transfers.

limitations: Do not reinterpret the finite reference-area undamped whole-boundary compliant plane as exact rigid-floor contact.
A softer boundary, damping, reduced impact, altered material or different contact law is a distinct future physical experiment, never a repair or reclassification of original negatives.

An implicit-midpoint contact path would additionally require a consistent root-split contact HVP/tangent and nonsmooth-time controls; the current force-only GPU root operator does not supply that qualification.
Direct96k use of old dense scalar mass+Cholesky would require~276GiB; no such run is proposed.
